kamo_oalewa.description: Kamo'oalewa is a very small, elongated asteroid belonging to the Apollo group of near-Earth objects.

donaldjohanson.name: Donaldjohanson
donaldjohanson.description: Lucy flew past it on April 20, 2025. It is about 8 km long and 3.5 km wide, a C-type (carbon-rich) asteroid, named for the paleoanthropologist who discovered the "Lucy" fossil.

vesta.name: Vesta
vesta.description: One of the largest objects in the asteroid belt, visited by NASA's Dawn mission.

churyumov.name: Churyumov
churyumov.description: 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko is the comet visited by the Rosetta spacecraft, August 2014 through September 2016.

hale_bopp.description: Visible to the naked eye for a record 18 months.

halley.description: The most famous periodic comet. Its orbit runs backward compared with the planets, and its dust gives two meteor showers each year, the Eta Aquarids and the Orionids.

encke.description: A short-period comet whose dust trail is the source of the Taurid meteor showers.

hyakutake.name: Hyakutake
hyakutake.description: Passed very close to Earth in 1996. It goes around the Sun in the opposite direction to the planets.

lemmon.name: Lemmon
lemmon.description: In fall 2025 it brightened in the morning northern sky. It goes around the Sun in the opposite direction to the planets.

ikeya_seki.name: Ikeya-Seki

neowise.name: NEOWISE
neowise.description: The brightest comet seen from the Northern Hemisphere since Hale-Bopp in 1997. It goes around the Sun in the opposite direction to the planets.

period.center_label: the solar system's center of mass

swan.name: SWAN
swan.description: A long-period comet, discovered on September 11, 2025.

maps.name: MAPS
maps.description: Kreutz sungrazer comet discovered on 13 January 2026 from the AMACS1 Observatory in the Atacama Desert, Chile.

voyager_1.name: Voyager 1
voyager_1.description: Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 is the farthest spacecraft from Earth. In 2012 it became the first spacecraft to reach interstellar space.

voyager_2.name: Voyager 2
voyager_2.description: Launched in 1977, Voyager 2 is the only spacecraft to have visited all four giant planets, and the only one to visit Uranus and Neptune.

new_horizons.name: New Horizons
new_horizons.description: New Horizons flew past Pluto in July 2015 and past Arrokoth on January 1, 2019. It is still travelling outward through the Kuiper Belt.

juno.name: Juno
juno.description: NASA's Juno has orbited Jupiter since July 2016, studying its interior, its atmosphere and the region its magnetic field controls, the magnetosphere.

osiris_apex.name: OSIRISAPE
osiris_apex.description: OSIRIS-APEX, formerly OSIRIS-REx, is on its way to asteroid Apophis. It reaches Apophis in June 2029, soon after the asteroid passes close to Earth in April 2029.

parker_solar_probe.name: Parker
parker_solar_probe.description: NASA's Parker Solar Probe, launched in August 2018, became the first spacecraft to fly through the corona, the Sun's upper atmosphere, in 2021. It studies how the corona is heated and what speeds up the solar wind.

lucy.name: Lucy
lucy.description: NASA's Lucy, launched in October 2021, is on its way to the Trojan asteroids, which share an orbit around the Sun with Jupiter.

juice.name: JUICE
juice.description: ESA's Juice (Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer), launched in April 2023, reaches Jupiter in July 2031. It will study the planet and its three large moons that hold oceans: Ganymede, Callisto and Europa.

psyche_spacecraft.name: Psyche
psyche_spacecraft.description: NASA's Psyche spacecraft, launched in October 2023, is on its way to the metal-rich asteroid 16 Psyche in the main asteroid belt. It begins exploring the asteroid by August 2029.

europa_clipper.name: Clipper
europa_clipper.description: NASA's Europa Clipper, launched in October 2024, reaches Jupiter in April 2030. It will fly past Jupiter's moon Europa 49 times, to learn whether the ocean thought to lie under its ice could support life.

bepicolombo.name: BepiColombo
bepicolombo.description: BepiColombo, led by ESA with Japan's space agency JAXA, launched in October 2018 to study Mercury from orbit.

solar_orbiter.name: SolO
solar_orbiter.description: Solar Orbiter, an ESA mission with a NASA contribution, launched in February 2020 to study the Sun up close. It has taken the first close-up pictures of the Sun's poles.
